name: exasol
description: Interact with Exasol databases using the exapump CLI tool. Upload CSV/Parquet files, run SQL queries, export data, leverage Exasol-specific SQL features, design tables with DISTRIBUTE BY/PARTITION BY, write UDFs in Python/Java/Lua/R, build custom Script Language Containers, manage BucketFS files, and run AI/NLP workloads inside Exasol using the Transformers Extension and Text AI Extension via the notebook-connector Python API.
